Chapter 559: Chapter 11 Fifteen Years Later (Please Subscribe)

Time passed, and in the blink of an eye, fifteen years had gone by.

Milky Way Main Star, Star Lord’s Great Hall.

Lin Yuan’s true body was sitting cross-legged, and in the small area before him, space vibrated subtly, and time also began to twist.

Whirr, whirr, whirr!!!

The flow rate of time in the area sometimes increased, sometimes slowed down.

“Since I began to understand the Rule of Time nine years ago, the speed of subsequent insights has become slower and slower,” Lin Yuan looked at the area with varying rates of time flow, “It seems that the hope of fully understanding the complete Time Rules at the Ninth Rank is not very great.”

...

“Even if I were to forcefully comprehend it with Against-Heaven’s Understanding, it would probably take a hundred thousand to several hundred thousand years. With that effort, I could have already struck to reach the Supreme Being realm,” Lin Yuan thought silently to himself.

The Rule of Time, for a Ninth Rank breaking through to Tenth Rank, was of no help,

nor was there anything like a foundation’s enhancement.

Normally, a Ninth Rank Evolver would not invest too much of their time and effort into the Rule of Time,

as it was completely a bottomless pit, and only Lin Yuan with his Against-Heaven’s Understanding even attempted it for a few years, finally concluding that to fully understand the Rule of Time, he would need a hundred thousand years.

Of course, the hundred thousand years mentioned here refers to the time at the Ninth Rank.

Once Lin Yuan steps into Tenth Rank, let alone Tier 11, under the high-standing perspective, comprehending time would certainly be greatly reduced.

“Actually, compared to the Space Rules, the effect of the Time Rules is quite underwhelming; it’s tied to one’s own foundation, and without a sufficiently high Life Essence, it’s basically of little use,”

Lin Yuan shook his head slightly.

Take, for instance, some of the ancient Eleventh-Rank Life forms, of whom a very small number had also understood the Rule of Time.

But do these ancient Eleventh-Rank Life forms dare to step into the River of Time and go against the flow to resurrect past deceased lives?

They dare not.

Even resurrecting the weakest Sixth Rank Life, they dare not.

They have the ability to do it, but they do not dare.

Because it goes against the operating rules of the Main Universe, and once they do it, they must face the backlash of the Main Universe.

The depth of the Supreme Being’s Life Essence is unimaginably thick, capable of withstanding the backlash brought by ‘resurrection,’ but those at Tier 11 are far from having such capability.

Now that Lin Yuan has just begun to understand the Rule of Time, he can only manage to speed up time or slow it down, and compared with the flow rate of time in the Main World, he can achieve up to threefold at most.

Whether it’s speeding up or slowing down time, it can be maintained for only up to twenty breaths, and the range of coverage, once exceeding three zhang around the body, will see the duration sharply plummet.

If the area covered by the accelerated or decelerated time encompasses an Evolver whose Life Essence is higher than Lin Yuan’s, it might even collapse prematurely.

It’s like trying to trap a whale with a small fishing net.

As for slowing down the time flow rate at his body’s exterior, achieving an external year while only a day has passed for oneself, reaching an alternative form of ‘life-extension’…

It can only just manage to extend life.

When the flow rate of time differs from that of the Main Universe, the sensation towards many Universal Rules and the Great Dao will become blurry.

Time is a pillar among the rules, and it is only with the blessing of the force of time that life is able to sense the fluctuations and changes of the various Great Dao rules.

If the Time Rules are inconsistent with the Main Universe, it amounts to actively severing the path that perceives the operation of the Universal Great Dao rules.

Unless within the area of time flow rate, a new operation of Great Dao rules can be reconstructed.

During Lin Yuan’s eight traversals, each time the world he traversed had a different time flow rate than the Main Universe, but he could still sense the Great Dao rules.

It is because within the flow rate of time in those worlds, there is a corresponding operation of Great Dao rules.

“The Xuanhuang Secret Realm…”

Lin Yuan glanced at the depths of space; in the past fifteen years, his Taiyang Divine Spirit had almost walked through most of the inner region.

In another five or six years at most, he would be able to enter the core area.

…

The Xuanhuang Secret Realm.

Deep within the heavy layers of the spatial layers.

Lin Yuan and Xilan were on their journey.

It had to be said that traveling with Xilan had greatly improved Lin Yuan’s efficiency.

Although Xilan’s combat power was ordinary, she excelled at ‘transitioning’ between the spatial layers, and with Lin Yuan following her, they could often save a lot of trouble.

For example, upon encountering a difficult indigenous life form, often just as the indigenous life form started to perceive the fluctuations deep within a spatial layer, Xilan would already have taken Lin Yuan far away.

The indigenous life form wouldn’t even have time to pursue them.

“The Xuanhuang Secret Realm has been open for over twenty years now…” Xilan said while traveling, her tone slightly heavy.

“Many of the friends who entered the Secret Realm with me have died,” Xilan sighed, “If I hadn’t heeded your advice to stay away from those fortune spots, I probably would be in danger by now too.”

Fortune spots are where treasures emerge, presenting great opportunities as well as great risks.

As many Alien Strong Ones rush there, fighting for treasures could mean death at the hands of one of those Alien Strong Ones.

On this trip to the Xuanhuang Secret Realm, Xilan had already reaped considerable rewards, including that unfathomable black sphere beforehand, and had also been lucky to enter a fortune spot previously.

Now, for Xilan, the most important thing was to complete the journey safely.

“Indeed,” Lin Yuan nodded.

Over the past twenty years or so, he had also made some acquaintances among human Ninth Rank Evolvers, learning some information about this entry into the Xuanhuang Secret Realm.

“Nowadays, the Xuanhuang Secret Realm is not safe anywhere. Those Alien Strong Ones lurking in the outer regions are probably rich in harvest and want to leave the Secret Realm alive…,” Xilan said with a trace of mockery on her face, “but now hundreds of Myriad Heavy Realm and Million Heavy Realm Ninth Rank Alien Strong Ones have started to sweep the outer regions.”

Upon hearing this, Lin Yuan showed no surprise.

Having been open for over twenty years, the Xuanhuang Secret Realm has those who survived until now at the Ninth Rank, basically all having some gains, which makes them a hunting target for those Ninth Rank Alien Strong Ones of hundreds of Myriad Heavy Realm and Million Heavy Realm.
